sources.scope: 17 class profiles, Hit Dice and fixed later-level HP bases; required by the shared source-binding validator.
Start one attempt and the one-shot unattended Trap: setup/exposure, commitment, fixed minute-55 check, capture retention, retrieval, custody, allowance and abandonment.

implementations.name: Schema37 TEST_ONLY physical unattended Trap and retrieval lifecycle
implemented: Preserve historical schema35 no-bait and schema36 bait/timing wire projections; schema37 appends finite opportunity, physical creature, Trap, receiving-location and retrieval state.
Reserve finite fixture opportunity, actual candidate body, physical Trap and one compatible ordinary bait portion before setup; pre-exposure cancellation releases only unspent reservations.
At completed setup/exposure spend bait and opportunity once, snapshot setter WIS/proficiency, deploy the Trap, and keep the check at attempt start + 55 minutes.
Use the fixture-supplied setter's own WIS and fishing-tackle profile; keep site, Trap and receiving-location identities supplied by the world fixture.
Resolve one deterministic check with untrained disadvantage and all four task degrees; successful capture retains the same creature body inside the Trap and awards no inventory lot.
Reserve an intact, supported, capacity-checked receiver and legal cord-length route before five active retrieval minutes; require an idle capable two-handed worker adjacent to the Trap.
Persist partial retrieval labor through pause and save/restore; permit a different capable adjacent worker to resume and receive custody.
At coincident deadlines resolve the scheduled fishing check before retrieval; early retrieval cancels the pending check without RNG or catch and does not refund spent inputs.

Keep the actual Trap and captured-creature identities, location, custody and recovery evaluation connected through retrieval or abandonment. Active retrieval is paused, with its destination reservation retained, if the setter abandons the Trap.

Initialize multiple independently supplied site/Trap profiles in one TEST_ONLY snapshot with stable order-independent content identity; exercise sequential setup, capture, retrieval and save/restore for each profile while preserving the other profile's state.

Allow distinct opportunity and stock-version labels to reference one shared actual creature body; reserve its response once at exposure, spend the losing committed opportunity and bait without a replacement response, and retain its empty physical Trap for retrieval.
notImplemented: Versioned finite stock-member manifests and candidate sets; arbitrary overlapping allocation-set audits across differently labeled sites/routes; multi-creature weighting, renewal, attraction paths, hazards or prey movement/anatomy admission.
Complete assembly subcomponent histories, Rod, Net, attended fishing, assistants, equipment bonuses, magical bait receipts/suppression and general bait compatibility.
Escaped/released prey, general physical receiver layouts/elevations, deployment allowance reconciliation, lawful holder handover and a generalized inventory/custody model for all catches.
Production rule authority, Unity-host integration, presentation and complete exploration-to-management gameplay.
